description: mailbox.rs role_to_wire uses serde_json::to_value(role).ok().and_then(...).unwrap_or_default(). If serde returns a non-string variant (unexpected but possible if MailboxRole gains a non-camelCase variant or serde impl changes), the function silently returns "". This empty string then compares unequal to any real role string, silently allowing duplicate role assignments for any non-representable role. The function should return Option<String> or &str (via a match or AsRef), so callers handle the failure explicitly. unwrap_or_default on an invariant that must not fail turns silent corruption into a debugging nightmare.
title: role_to_wire silently returns empty string for unknown MailboxRole variants
